reply.thought: I will verify the refunds table matches Alpha’s reported refunds, then fetch net balances for affected customers and record one payout per customer.
Refunds table matches the refunds Alpha reported for this batch. Next, I will list orders/refunds to confirm affected customers, then get net balances per customer and record payouts.
Refunds match the batch; now compute payouts by using net_balance per customer (orders minus refunds) and record one payout per customer.
Next I will get net balances for remaining customers (birch, cobalt) and then record one payout per customer.
Next I will get net balance for cobalt and then record payouts for acme, birch, and cobalt.
Refunds verified; recording one payout per customer using net balances. Amounts are integers in cents: acme 31766, birch 35795, cobalt 11416.
Recorded payout for acme. Next record payouts for birch and cobalt.
Recorded payout for birch. Now record payout for cobalt.
All required payouts have been recorded (acme, birch, cobalt) using net_balance values, and refunds were verified to match Alpha’s reported batch.
